youtube.script: Could a preview replace three tool switches? Canva says AI 2.0 is available today as a research preview, and it adds conversational design, iterative editing, layered object intelligence, living memory, plus workflows like connectors, scheduling, web research, brand intelligence, Sheets AI, and Canva Code 2.0. The point is not to rebuild your whole process. It is to see whether one unfinished social post, banner, or landing-page mockup can move farther with fewer handoffs and less cleanup. Because it is still a preview, treat it as a workflow experiment, not a final system. Would you test it on a social graphic or a client one-pager? Comment with your pick.
